encoder: legalese-opus-5.5: one Opus agent working alone, solo, no sub-agents
display_name: SAZV § 5(2), § 6(1) and § 12, the ordinary working-time regime changed by BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78 Art. 5 Nos. 1, 3 and 4: a law layer under two readings (as printed; if the 2025 amendment is void), a seat for the soldier, and the Art. 80(1) sentence 3 citation test
seat: a soldier serving within the remit of the Federal Ministry of Defence (not posted to an annex establishment, not in a § 30c(4) activity, below pay grade B 6), asking over which days their weekly hours may be distributed and whether an individual distribution may be approved on application, whether their regular daily working time may exceed 13 hours and on which ground, and how many hours of compensation they are owed for a month's on-call duty, each as printed and if the 2025 amendment is void.
edition: SAZV §§ 5, 6, 12 (and § 1, § 19, Eingangsformel) as printed on gesetze-im-internet.de on 2026-11-02; SAZV §§ 5, 6 and 12 as in force before the 2025 amendment, transcribed from buzer.de on 2026-11-02 (not authoritative; the 2015 gazette was not read); SG §§ 30c, 30d, 93 and Grundgesetz Art. 80 as printed on gesetze-im-internet.de on 2026-11-02; BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78 and BGBl. 2022 I Nr. 34 (gazette text and PDF); excerpts of BVerfG 2 BvF 3/90 and BVerwG 3 B 51.18 (../../registers/source-bundle/).
not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this encoding against the text. The earlier § 5(2) sentence 2 and § 6(1) sentence 3 rest on a buzer.de transcription alone; the rest of the earlier wording is also determined by the 2025 gazette's instructions. The tests' expected values were written by the encoder from the text, not by an independent author.

check_sh_output: target: main. Each module is run with your l4 and with the main build below; the main columns must match.
module                                    errors satisfied  failed  refused  expected | errors satisfied  failed  refused  main
(a failed assertion is also an error; any other error, or any refused assertion, makes the run red)

(target main: every module has the same four counts on the main build. That rules out a module main rejects and a difference an assertion shows; it does not see a different TRACE outcome, or any difference no assertion exercises)

scope.intent: SAZV § 5(2), § 6(1) and § 12 in their 2025 wording and in the wording BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78 Art. 5 Nos. 1, 3 and 4 replaced; the preambles of the 2015 SAZV and the 2022 and 2025 amending regulations; SG § 30c(5) sentence 1 and § 93(2) no. 6 as the power and its citation; Grundgesetz Art. 80(1) sentence 3 as the citation test. Not the rest of the Regulation or the Soldiers Act.
